sec.title: August 27 Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 223)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **August 27** across American network radio, Curley Bradley capturing the rustlers on *Tom Mix Ralston Straight Shooters* for Ralston Purina, Warren Somerville directing modern psychological drama on *Theater Five*, Edward R. Murrow's live London rooftop reporting during the Battle of Britain, and Vincent Price starring as *The Saint* in two gripping crime cases (1947 Breeze Detergent baby adoption ring and 1950 cupid extortion) (1940–1964):
